texts.zh:
皇帝下诏要求我们把精力集中在王朝本身。一块特殊的统治芯片会被植入每一位未来的统治者，以记录并转移他们作为[root.GetName]的[root.GetRulerTitle]期间的经验。

随着统治芯片的代代相传，其蕴含的丰富经验将成为我们社会的重要记录。另外，我们也可以利用人民的知识来增益领袖。
texts.en:
The imperial seat has decreed our efforts be focused on the dynasty itself. A special RulerChip will be implanted on all future rulers to record and transfer their experiences as the [root.GetRulerTitle] of the [root.GetName]. This relic chip will then be transferred to the heir at the time of the ruler's passing.

As the RulerChip is passed on through generations, its vast library of experiences will become the foundational record of our society. We can also leverage our population's learnings for our leaders' benefit.

texts.zh:
为了缓解我们帝国公民的辛劳，必须在[root.Capital.GetName]/“建立一座宏伟的义体斗兽场。它将会成为新式义体运动的举办场所，强化过的运动员们将为了我们的青睐和景仰争奇斗艳。目睹如此尖端的竞争无疑能激起大众对[root.GetName]的崇拜之情。

此外，这些景象还可以通过神经广播直接传达到全帝国的义体大脑中，驱使热情的人群前往[root.Capital.GetName]，亲身体验这种行为的原始刺激。
texts.en:
To offer our imperial citizens respite from their toil, a great Cyberdome must be built on [root.Capital.GetName]. It will serve as the glorious venue for new kinds of cybersports, where augmented athletes compete for our favor and admiration. Witnessing such fierce competition will surely invigorate the masses and their admiration for the [root.GetName].

Furthermore, these spectacles can be neurocasted straight into the cyberbrain, which will compel the exuberant crowds to travel to [root.Capital.GetName] and experience the primal thrill of the action firsthand.

texts.zh:
我们社会在义体领域的发展走到了一个岔路口。我们可以致力于造福少数人或是大众上。无论作何选择都将为[root.GetName]带来好处。

开发一种专业的植入体可以让我们将[root.GetRulerTitle]的经验传承给子嗣。而着力发展强化义体运动和广播科技则可以让我们可以在[root.Capital.GetName]的首都举办盛大的赛事活动。
texts.en:
Our societal advancement in the field of cybernetics is at a crossroads. We can either concentrate our efforts for the benefit of the few or the many. Both would ultimately serve the [root.GetName] well.

Developing a specialized implant would allow us to transfer the experiences of the [root.GetRulerTitle] to the heir. Emphasis on augmented cybersports and broadcasting technologies would allow us to organize magnificent events on our capital of [root.Capital.GetName].

summary.text:
# 帝国万岁 / Long Live the Empire

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/machine_age_situation_events_1.txt:5932-6094

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “未来冲击”事件链的终点：休闲/社会事件结束后180+随机90天，隐藏事件 cyber.1500 按政体权威（switch has_authority）分发：民主 1505、寡头 1510、独裁 1515、帝制 1520、企业 1525。
  End of the "Future Shock" chain: 180 days (+ random 90) after the leisure/society event hidden cyber.1500 switches on has_authority: democratic 1505, oligarchic 1510, dictatorial 1515, imperial 1520, corporate 1525.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「帝制政体」的最终事件：国家选择个人主义（cyber_individualist）或集体主义（cyber_collectivist）的网络化取向，设置相应国家标志；另有一个保留现状的选项。
  The final event for imperial governments: the country picks an individualist (cyber_individualist) or collectivist (cyber_collectivist) orientation of cyberization and the matching country flag is set; a third option keeps the status quo.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 故事终点；五个政体版本互斥（由 has_authority 决定）。
  The end of the chain; the five authority versions are exclusive (by has_authority).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 仅出现给帝制权威的国家。
  Shown only to imperial (authority auth_imperial) countries.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 说明：这十个最终事件（cyber/synth 1505–1525）不在任何审阅者的分配列表中，作为连带内容一并审阅。
  Note: these ten final events (cyber/synth 1505-1525) are in no reviewer's assignment list and were reviewed as part of the same chains.
- 已核对：触发条件、选项效果；编译树与脚本一致。
  Checked: trigger conditions and option effects; the compiled tree matches the script.
